scope_label: D4b half 2 - the previously UNREVIEWED files of the same slice
reviewed_hash_basis: sha256 over the concatenation of .claude/scripts/qa-gate.sh and .claude/scripts/review-check.sh in that order; independently reproduced by the orchestrator AND by the reviewer (hash_reproduced=yes)
why_this_round_exists: Rounds r1-r4 of this slice each scoped themselves to epic-gate.sh and plan-batches.test.sh; every finding in all four artifacts located to one of those two files. qa-gate.sh (+178, cmd_design_unit_show/cmd_design_status) and review-check.sh (+39/-27, unit_files/unit_deps on the validate-design envelope) carry the same (v5 D4b, fkm.6) sentinels and had never been reviewed by anyone. See claude-workflow-plugin-z7ni.
stop_condition: every extraction, jq call and command substitution in scope audited for rc-AND-shape discipline; envelope contract parity checked on every emission path including error/early-return; behaviours with no test anywhere enumerated

findings.description: The validate-design success path contains FIVE consecutive fail-open extractions and then emits ok:true unconditionally. A consumer cannot distinguish a genuinely dependency-free or unit-free design from a computation that never produced one.
findings.evidence: Orchestrator-verified by reading :866-876. Every one of `n`, `ids`, `art_tid`, `ufiles`, `udeps` is `$(...) || <default>` with defaults 0, [], "", {}, {} respectively; :875 then calls emit_validate_design "true" with no rc or shape check. A failed `.units | length` reads as 'zero units'; a failed id extraction reads as 'no unit ids'. NOTE: the reviewer named two of the five (ufiles, udeps); the orchestrator established that all five share the defect. This is the SIXTH instance of this class in this slice.
findings.suggested_fix: Compute n, unit_ids, task_id, unit_files and unit_deps in ONE guarded jq -e pass; test its rc AND validate that both maps are objects whose keys exactly match unit_ids and whose values are arrays. Emit ok:false with a computation-failed key on any failure. Reserve {} for error envelopes or a genuinely empty map.

findings.description: design-unit-show reports an UNREADABLE binding source as the legitimate determined result ok:true,bound:false. require_bd only proves the bd executable and .beads directory exist; it does not prove either bd show form succeeded or returned parseable comments.
findings.evidence: Reviewer established statically: require_bd at :2690-2699 checks only `command -v bd` and the directory; bd_show_with_comments at :1490-1493 ends in `|| true`; latest_design_unit_binding at :8117-8128 converts bd/jq failures to {} and always returns 0; :8557-8562 then emits ok:true,bound:false.
findings.suggested_fix: Give the authoritative binding reader a failure channel: capture the bd-chain rc, require a parseable expected shape, return nonzero on unreadable data, and have design-unit-show emit ok:false with a specific error_key.

findings.description: The bound:true envelope is not validated as a coherent shape. design_task, unit_id and design_hash are extracted by three independent jq calls that each default failure to empty string, but only unit_id is tested, so a selective failure emits bound:true with required fields empty.
findings.evidence: Reviewer established statically from :8553-8555 and :8557-8571; the branch predicate tests only `[ -z "$unit_id" ]`.
findings.suggested_fix: Validate binding_json once with jq -e against the complete union shape - either {} for confirmed absence, or an object with non-empty design_task and unit_id plus a 64-hex design_hash. Capture and test rc; refuse partial or malformed objects.

findings.description: Both new accessors can exit 0 after failing to construct valid JSON. Their jq encoders run inside printf argument substitutions; under set -e, failure of an inner substitution does not abort when the outer printf succeeds, so malformed JSON is emitted with a success status.
findings.evidence: Reviewer established statically at :8566-8571 and :8614-8620 (every caller-derived string encoded by an unchecked `$(... | jq -Rs .)`) and by execution: `bash -c 'set -e; printf "{\"x\":%s}\n" "$(false)"; printf "continued rc=%s\n" "$?"'` printed `{"x":}` then `continued rc=0`.
findings.suggested_fix: Construct each envelope with one guarded `jq -nc` assignment using `cmd || rc=$?`; test rc and non-empty parseable output before printing. On construction failure emit a caller-data-free literal error envelope and exit nonzero.

findings.description: design-status cannot distinguish an unreadable Beads/comments source from a task that genuinely has no design; both return ok:true,satisfied:false,error_key:no_design_attempted. Fail-safe for serialisation, but it violates the requirement that a failed computation degrade loudly rather than masquerade as ordinary absence.
findings.evidence: Reviewer established statically: compute_design_satisfied at :7213 calls latest_design_artifact_designer, which at :7134-7145 suppresses bd and jq failures and always returns 0; :7214-7217 convert empty output to no_design_attempted; :8614 emits ok:true unconditionally.
findings.suggested_fix: Propagate source-read status through latest_design_artifact_designer and compute_design_satisfied; return a distinct unavailable key for bd failure, malformed JSON or unreadable comments, and have design-status emit ok:false with a nonzero infrastructure exit while retaining satisfied:false.

coverage_gaps.behaviour: validate-design must refuse when the final unit_deps/unit_files extraction fails after schema and cycle validation succeeded
coverage_gaps.why_uncovered: Orchestrator-verified: the ONLY occurrence of the string unit_deps in .claude/scripts/tests/ is a COMMENT at plan-batches.test.sh:690. No test forces the extraction to fail or asserts ok:true is impossible afterward.

coverage_gaps.behaviour: Every validate-design error envelope, including the pre-dispatch jq-missing path, must carry unit_files:{} and unit_deps:{}
coverage_gaps.why_uncovered: No test assertion reads .unit_deps from a validate-design envelope.

coverage_gaps.behaviour: design-unit-show must distinguish a successfully-read task with no binding from failure of both bd show attempts or malformed comment JSON
coverage_gaps.why_uncovered: No direct invocation or assertion of design-unit-show in any test source; no case forces the binding read to fail while bd and .beads remain present.

coverage_gaps.behaviour: design-unit-show bound:true must require non-empty design_task and a valid design_hash under selective jq-extraction failure
coverage_gaps.why_uncovered: No test asserts the complete bound:true envelope shape.

coverage_gaps.behaviour: Neither accessor may exit 0 with malformed output when its final JSON encoder fails
coverage_gaps.why_uncovered: No accessor test forces the final encoder failure and asserts both output validity and exit status.

notes: Read-only review; no suite was run (a fix round was editing epic-gate.sh, plan-batches.test.sh and docs/HOOKS.md concurrently, and those three were excluded as a moving target). Reviewer reproduced the scope hash twice; the orchestrator reproduced it independently. bash -n passes for both files. The reviewer established NO character-class mismatch between DESIGN-UNIT writer and reader, no suffix-token injection, no first/last parser divergence, no unsafe safety-field polarity, and no new bare `var=$(cmd); rc=$?` errexit violation in scope. H2-F1's breadth (five extractions, not two) was established by the orchestrator, not the reviewer.
